data.body:
Phase 1 confirmed RCA (rebar-debug).

Proven root cause: test fixtures intentionally operating on bare repositories erase repository-kind intent by routing those commands through generic helpers that encode only `cwd=<bare>` or `git -C <bare>`. Git 2.55 intentionally rejects those implicit-discovery forms under protected `safe.bareRepository=explicit`; it accepts the identical repositories when explicitly selected with top-level `--git-dir`. The changeable artifacts are the bare-repository call sites/helper seams in tests, not the protected Git setting. Generic helpers also serve worktrees, so blanket conversion would regress worktree semantics.

Runtime proof: E1 used one valid ephemeral bare repository with process-only strict config (`GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null`, `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1`, `safe.bareRepository=explicit`). Implicit cwd config and `git -C ... symbolic-ref` both returned 128 with the reported errors; changing only targeting to `git --git-dir` returned 0 with exact `false` pin and `refs/heads/tickets` state. Default-config implicit controls returned 0. Invalid ref and nonexistent git-dir remained rc128, ruling out error masking. E2 traced the real fixtures: concurrency invoked `git config gc.autoDetach false` with PWD at remote.git; prepare/reclaim invoked `git -C source.git symbolic-ref ...`; all three errored in fixture setup before product code, while identical default controls passed 3/3. E3 proved mixed-helper dependency: unchanged worktree `-C` succeeded under strict policy, explicitly targeted bare calls preserved all three required pins, and blanket `--git-dir <worktree-path>` failed rc128. This rules out venv/Python, repository validity/ownership, safe.directory, product force/transition/claim code, platform behavior, and protected-config precedence.

Archaeology/safety: commit 07e76a1ce3 and closed bugs ambery-candied-binturong / amicable-unsure-barasinga make all three upkeep pins, `--no-hardlinks`, checked failures, and absence of retry/swallowing load-bearing corruption defenses. Trusted prior art `test_epoch_guard_reconciliation.py::_bare_git` from 019e32e03d1 uses explicit `--git-dir` and passes strict policy. Deliberate safe.bareRepository=all uses in the live S3 workflow and reconcile retry tests are distinct contracts and must remain untouched.

Legitimacy: defect. The user explicitly requires supported tests to run locally and in CI; AGENTS.md portability and failure-investigation contracts prohibit dismissing reproducible local failures. Git documents `explicit` as the Git 3.0 default. Existing fixtures contract successful initialization.

Expected repair invariant: commands intentionally operating on a bare test repository identify it explicitly; worktree calls retain existing `-C`/cwd behavior; all command arguments, exact pins/refs/results, `--no-hardlinks`, checked fail-fast behavior, and genuine Git errors remain unchanged. The confirmed construct census spans reported reclaim/concurrency fixtures plus other test-only bare helpers; no production caller is implicated.
